[6:35PM] #Marina #TrafficUpdate

Good traffic conditions observed at Cathedral Church.
Unimpeded traffic movement from State House inward to McWen and connecting Force Road.
Good traffic flow from Zone 2 Underneath Bridge towards Flagstaff House, connecting to McWen Bridge.
Smooth traffic movement from Onikan Roundabout by TBS onward to Water Board, connecting to Nitel Intersection.
Good traffic conditions on Broad Street, from General Hospital towards Mr. Biggs by Joseph Harden Street.
Slow traffic movement approaching Balogun Junction inward Apongbon.
Good traffic conditions on Igbosere Road.
Smooth traffic flow from Catholic Mission Street connecting Ganiu Smith Street.

[6:47PM] #Anthony #TrafficUpdate 

Improved traffic movement from the foot of Dorman Long Bridge inw Fadeyi, Onipanu, down to Palm Grove, Obanikoro, and up to Anthony.
Smooth traffic flow from Anthony inward to Idiroko, Maryland, Odo Iyalaro, and up to New Garage.
Good traffic conditions on the return journey from the Interchange, Motorway down to Ojota, with both the service lane and main carriageway experiencing unimpeded traffic flow.
Uninterrupted traffic movement from Ojota down to New Garage, Odo Iyalaro, Independence Tunnel, and further down to Idiroko, Anthony, Obanikoro, Palm Grove, inward Onipanu, and up to Fadeyi.
